purpose: Saved-snapshot geometry supplement; no simulation, renderer change, or artistic sufficiency claim.

method.sourceGrid: 96x96 cell masks; centroid coordinates use index/(dimension-1). Negative space is the 4-neighbor complement of the material union inside the finite grid; it does not measure perceived blankness or pheromone gaps.
method.cohortComparison: Compare different completed consecutive birth-time windows at the 7200s endpoint. Empty bins are counted but excluded from cohort shape IoU. Recent 120s cohorts at 900/1800/3600/7200s are distinct cohorts.
method.topPartition: Within-run four-neighbor internal boundaries counted once over common occupied support; exterior edges excluded. ARI is contingency-based; union and negative-space IoUs are separate.

topPartition.exterior: excluded from internal-edge comparison; union silhouette is reported separately
